cases.name: Cynthia "Cindy" Leslie
cases.about: She was a 1973 graduate of Toms River High School South and a clerk at Ocean County Advertising Service.
cases.narrative: On 3/03/1974, a woman walking her dog found her body in a wooded are between Messenger and Water streets in Toms River, NJ. She had failed to return to work after going to lunch. She had been stabbed and strangled to death with her own belt.

cases.name: Suzanne Garden
cases.about: She was a freshman at Toms River High School South.
cases.narrative: On 3/02/1974, her partially nude body was found in a wooded area off Garfield Ave. one mile from her home. She had been beaten and stabbed and was strangled to death. She was last seen leaving her home at 329 Morris Blvd. in Toms River, NJ.
